{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the channels
print("Channels:", df['channel'].unique())

# Check the status
print("Status values:", df['status'].unique())

# Check conversion status
print("Conversion rate overall:", df['converted'].mean())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check customer_segment
print("Customer segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Confirm the premises
print("Premise 1: Only two channels?", set(df['channel'].unique()) == {'email', 'paid_search'})
print("Premise 2: Email targeted at loyal?", 'loyal' in df[df['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Premise 3: Refunded orders exist?", 'refunded' in df['status'].unique())
print("Premise 4: Conversion is 1 when completed?", df[df['converted'] == 1]['status'].unique() == ['completed'])"}
